notes.title: Updated Trailer, Demo Coming SOON, for Bad Heroes
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is *less than 1 month away* which means the very first downloadable demo for Bad Heroes is *less than 1 month away* and we can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on 

Dating sim? 🫶
Beat em up? 💪
Office romance? 💘 Hell yeah

So wishlist us and get ready
Let’s date some superheroes and punch some mimes!
